name: caption-knockout
title: Caption Knockout
description: A solid plate with the words cut clean through it, each word punching out the moment it is spoken so the footage shows through the letters.
useWhen: The footage is worth seeing and you want the caption to frame it rather than cover it: the letters are windows onto whatever plays behind them.
A bold, graphic caption for brand or launch video where a block of color is part of the look.
avoidWhen: The footage behind is flat or the same tone as the plate: the holes vanish; use caption-subtitle.
The viewer should read ahead of the voice in plain type: use caption-karaoke or caption-dim-progress.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Captions
variables.description: Word timings as JSON: [{"text","startMs","endMs"}] in milliseconds, or [{"text","start","end"}] in seconds. A transcript from Mosio works as is.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Caption text size in pixels (at 1080 px on the short side).

variables.label: Page window
variables.description: Words that start within this window share one page of captions. A sentence end always starts a new page.

variables.label: Hold
variables.description: How long the last page stays after its final word.

variables.label: Upcoming opacity
variables.description: How much of an unspoken word is already cut through the plate.

variables.label: Radius
variables.description: Corner radius of the plate as a fraction of the font size.
